admin.title: Admin
admin.lede: Your organisation, its people and its keys.
admin.organisation.title: Organisation
admin.organisation.lede: Deadlines and digests follow this timezone and these languages.
admin.organisation.name: Name
admin.organisation.timezoneHint: Deadlines are shown in this timezone.
admin.organisation.contentLanguagesHint: Summaries are offered in these languages, first one first.
admin.organisation.contentLanguagesRequi: Choose at least one content language.
admin.organisation.ai.title: Ask and AI drafts
admin.organisation.ai.on: On for {name}. Members can ask questions and have a model draft text for them.
admin.organisation.ai.off: Off for {name}. Ask and AI drafts are refused, and nothing of yours is sent to a model.
admin.organisation.ai.stepUpCancelled: Nothing changed. Switching needs your passkey.
admin.members.title: Members
admin.members.passkeys: {count, plural, =0 {No passkey} one {# passkey} other {# passkeys}}
admin.members.sessions: {count, plural, =0 {No session} one {# session} other {# sessions}}
admin.members.noInvitationsBody: Invite a person to get started.
admin.members.emptyBody: Invite the first person to your organisation.
admin.members.titleHint: Optional. Shown on the member list.
admin.members.rolesStepUp: Changing roles asks for your passkey.
admin.members.reissueLede: If this person lost every passkey, re-issue their enrolment. Every session ends, every passkey is retired, and they get a new invitation by email.
admin.members.reissueConfirm: Re-issue enrolment? Their sessions end and their passkeys stop working now.
admin.members.reissued: Enrolment re-issued. A new invitation is on its way.
admin.members.deactivateLede: Deactivating ends every session and keeps the history.
admin.members.lastAdmin: This is the last member who can manage members. Give someone else that role first.
admin.members.notFoundBody: There is no such member in your organisation.
admin.roles.title: Roles
admin.roles.lede: A role is a set of permissions. System roles can be renamed, not changed.
admin.roles.retireConfirm: Retire this role? Members who hold it keep their other roles.
admin.roles.usageNotePlaceholder: e.g. Reads cases and saves assessment input
admin.roles.keyRequired: Enter a key and an English label.
admin.apiKeys.title: API keys
admin.apiKeys.lede: For your own integrations. No key can change the library.
admin.apiKeys.newKeyBody: It is not shown again. Store it where your integration keeps secrets.
admin.apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? Anything using it stops working now.
admin.apiKeys.name: Name
admin.apiKeys.expiresHint: Optional. Leave empty for no expiry.
admin.apiKeys.stepUp: Creating a key asks for your passkey.
admin.apiKeys.emptyBody: Create a key when an integration needs one.
admin.apiKeys.scope.proposals:write: Submit proposals to the library queue
admin.securityLog.title: Security log
admin.securityLog.lede: Sign-ins, failures, enrolments, recoveries and key use. Nothing here can be edited.
admin.securityLog.emptyBody: Sign-ins and key use appear here as they happen.
admin.securityLog.errorTitle: Could not load the security log
admin.auditLog.title: Audit log
admin.auditLog.lede: Written in ink: every decision and edit, by whom and when. Entries are added, never changed or removed.
admin.auditLog.emptyBody: Every change anyone makes appears here as it happens.
admin.auditLog.emptyFiltered: No entry matches these filters. Widen the days, or clear the filters to see everything.
admin.auditLog.errorTitle: Could not load the audit log
admin.aiLog.title: AI log
admin.aiLog.lede: Everything a model wrote for your organisation, which model wrote it, and whether a person has stood behind it. Nothing here can be edited.
admin.aiLog.reportedByAgent: Model as reported by the agent
admin.aiLog.sources: {count, plural, =0 {No sources} one {# source} other {# sources}}
admin.aiLog.aiLabel: Written by AI. No person has confirmed it.
admin.aiLog.editedBy: Rewritten by {name}, {time}. The words below are the AI draft.
admin.aiLog.emptyBody: Every model call appears here as it is made.
admin.aiLog.emptyFiltered: No model call matches these filters.
admin.aiLog.errorTitle: Could not load the AI log
admin.org.form.name: Name
admin.org.form.stale: Someone changed this while you were editing. Close it and open it again to see their change.
admin.org.departments.title: Departments
admin.org.departments.lede: A department has a head, who sees the department's work on My work. Teams sit in a department.
admin.org.teams.title: Teams
admin.org.teams.lede: A team owns work and takes part in it, so ownership survives a person leaving. Who is in a team is set on the member.
admin.org.entities.title: Legal entities
admin.org.entities.lede: The group and the legal entities in it. Each entity ties to a legal-entity term, so the register can say where an obligation applies and where you comply, one entity at a time.
admin.org.entities.errorTitle: Could not load the legal entities
admin.org.entities.emptyBody: Add the group and each legal entity, then the licences and certificates each one holds.
admin.org.entities.addTitle: Add a legal entity or group
admin.org.entities.top: Nothing, it is at the top
admin.org.entities.leiHint: 20 letters and digits. Leave it empty if the entity has none.
admin.org.entities.countryHint: The two-letter code, such as SE.
admin.org.licences.title: Licences and certificates
admin.org.licences.lede: What each legal entity is licensed or certified for. A certificate's expiry and next audit show on the roadmap as your own deadlines.
admin.org.licences.errorTitle: Could not load the licences and certificates
admin.org.licences.ownerHint: They see the expiry and the next audit on the roadmap.
admin.org.licences.servicesHint: Terms from the lists obligations are scoped with.
admin.org.licences.withdrawnHint: Set it when the licence or certificate ends. It stays in the history.
admin.org.licences.addTo: Add a licence or certificate to {name}
admin.org.licences.addTitle: Add a licence or certificate to {name}
admin.org.products.title: Products
admin.org.products.lede: Products are scoped with the same terms as obligations, so the register can show which obligations reach a product.
admin.org.products.emptyBody: Add a product and scope it with the same terms your obligations use.
admin.org.products.termsHint: Terms from the lists obligations are scoped with.
admin.org.departments.emptyBody: Add the business areas, units and functions you work in, give each one a head, and put your teams in them.
admin.org.departments.head: Head: {name}
admin.org.departments.headHint: The head sees the department's work on My work.
admin.org.teams.name: Name
admin.org.teams.nameSvHint: Optional. Shown to people who read in Swedish.
admin.teams.member.title: Teams
admin.teams.member.hint: A team owns work and takes part in it, and reaches its active members. Teams themselves are set up under Organisation.
admin.teams.member.none: This organisation has no teams yet.
admin.members.removal.title: Deactivate {name}
admin.members.removal.owns: {name} owns open work. Choose who takes it over, a person or a team, for each kind.
admin.members.removal.takesPart: {count, plural, one {Takes part in # item. That ends; the item keeps its other participants.} other {Takes part in # items. That ends; the items keep their other participants.}}
admin.members.removal.teams: {count, plural, one {Teams: {teams}. {name} leaves it; what the team owns stays with the team.} other {Teams: {teams}. {name} leaves them all; what the teams own stays with the teams.}}
admin.members.removal.nothingYet: Nothing changes until you confirm. Then every item moves, every session ends and the history stays.
admin.members.removal.stillOwns: {name} still owns open work: {kinds}. Choose a new owner for each kind.
admin.members.removal.unknownOwner: Choose an active member other than {name}, or a team.
admin.members.removal.stepUpCancelled: Nothing changed. Deactivating needs your passkey.
